lines.t: They were waiting on a light, crowns on their sleeves
Pharisees plotting in the shadows of thieves
Quoting all the scrolls while their hearts loved war
Standing with the rulers yelling, crucify more
Wanted son of David with a sword in his hand
But Yahushua came lowly as the lamb for the land
Despised and rejected in their holy robes
Pierced their only hope, crowned him with thorns
You were waiting on the roar, got the silence of the lamb
Thought he crushed Rome, but he crushed us and our man
You crowned him with thorns, now he's crowned in blazing flame
Lion from the temple, he is coming in his name
Wrath of the lamb, all your empire's bout to fall
You serve Satan, now you shake when you hear the trumpet call
You were waiting on the roar, but the lamb already bled
Now the lion's at the door and he's coming for your head
Woe to you teachers, he exposed their pride
Modern Pharisees still whitey washing the outside
Twisting up the scriptures, built their system in the sand
Preaching the molded Messiah, not the lamb of God's command
Sold out the truth for tradition and fame
Mixed holy days while idols stamped his name
One broken word made the whole law fall Now the cup you filled is the wrath you call
You broke one word, now you're shackled in chains Turned grace to permission and honored your stains
You flirted with the world, with the dragon's throne Now the one you pierced is returning for his own
You were waiting on the roar, got the silence of the lamb Thought he crushed Rome, but he crushed us
And our man, you crowned him with thorns
Now he's crowned in blazing flame
Lion from the temple, he is coming in his name
Wrath of the lamb, all your empire's about to fall
Yusuf Satan, now you shake when you hear the trumpet call
You were waiting on the roar, but the lamb already bled
Now the lion's at the door and he's coming for your head
Kiss the sun, kiss the sun
Mountains start to tremble when the day has come
Kiss the star, kiss the star From death into life or from loud into grave
Passover blood is the only way you're saved I am risen, shakes the iron of the earth
Lion of Judah, roaring over second birth Every throne, every power in his hand
This world is a tree with its fruit turned black Every root in the soil pulling judgment back
You murdered the babies, filled the ground with blood Turned justice to worm with truth in the mud
Now the Holy One rises from his dwelling place Twenty-one strikes on a rebel race
Juan prays deep where the proud ones dine
Wrath of the lamb and the river of wine
He's the Passover sign, blood over the post
High priest, mercy seat, commander of post
You mocked his meekness, spit in his face
And Yahushua's gonna level this place
Heaven rolls back, every mountain lay low
Islands thus pure in the blaze of his glow
If you love this world, you can share its doom
When the line leaves the temple, Shio makes room
You were waiting on the road
He's the sun up, he's the sun up
He's the sun up, he's the sun up
He's the sun up
You were waiting on the road, got the silence or the lamb
But the silence gets shattered by the great I Am
Trumpets in the sky, kingdoms breaking like glass
Day of burning heat, gonna scorch up the grass
Better run to the lamb, for the lion appears
Or drown in your blood and your Babylon fears
He's the land of the dead, only all that will stand
Lion lamb, Yahushua ruler over every land
